desc:
🥚 Smash eggs, hatch pets and steal the rarest ones!

⚔️ FIGHT: Grab a weapon and break eggs. A bigger egg is luckier!
🐾 HATCH: Watch the luck climb before your egg pops, and find super rare pets!
🏃 STEAL: Get your pet home before the boss catches you, or it’s gone! You can also steal pets from other players’ bases.
💰 EARN: Your pets make cash every second, even while you’re offline!
👟 GET FASTER: Train on your treadmill to outrun bosses and thieves.
✨ MUTATIONS: Hunt for rare mutated pets!

🏆 Fill your Index and climb the leaderboards!

👍 Like and ⭐ favorite for updates!

badges.name: Welcome!
badges.desc: Play Slash to Steal an Egg!
